description: This file defines the 'StandardAoTCalculatorPage' class, which provides UI automation methods and properties for interacting with the calculator in Standard / AoT mode during automated UI testing. It includes methods for navigating modes, retrieving tooltips, checking button presence, and resizing the window to display certain UI elements.

classes.name: StandardAoTCalculatorPage
classes.description: Provides UI automation for the calculator in Standard / AoT mode, including mode navigation, tooltip retrieval, button presence checks, and window resizing.

methods.name: NavigateToStandardMode
methods.description: Navigates from AoT mode to Standard mode by clicking the 'ExitAlwaysOnTopButton' if present and verifying the mode change.

methods.name: NavigateToStandardAoTMode
methods.description: Ensures the calculator is in AoT mode by clicking the 'EnterAlwaysOnTopButton' and verifying the absence of the header.

methods.name: GetAoTToolTipText
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip text for the AoT button, moving the cursor over the button to trigger the tooltip.

methods.name: IsKeepOnTopButtonPresent
methods.description: Checks if the 'Keep on top' button is present in the current UI.

methods.name: IsInAlwaysOnTopMode
methods.description: Determines if the calculator is currently in AoT (Keep on top) mode based on UI elements.

methods.name: ResizeAoTWindowToDisplayInvertButton
methods.description: Resizes the calculator window to ensure the invert button is visible, starting from the top-left position.

methods.name: GrowWindowToShowInvertButton
methods.description: Recursively increases window height until the invert button is visible or a maximum height is reached.
